title: Separably closed fields
statement: A field $K$ [def-weil-field] is *separably closed* if every separable polynomial [def-pc-separable-polynomial] over $K$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] splits over $K$ (equivalently, $K$ admits no nontrivial finite separable field extension [def-pc-field-tower]). Here splitting means that the polynomial is a nonzero constant times a finite product of linear factors $T-a$ with $a\in K$, allowing an empty product. A *separable closure* of a field $K$ is a field extension $K^{\mathrm{sep}}/K$ [def-pc-field-extension] which is separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] and whose top field is separably closed.

mathlib_match.how: One declaration per definition: IsSepClosed (lines 66-67) is exactly the current blueprint's polynomial-splitting definition; IsSepClosure (lines 227-229) is a separably closed top field together with Algebra.IsSeparable for the extension (also isSepClosure_iff, lines 258-260). Algebra.IsSeparable.isAlgebraic (Mathlib/FieldTheory/Separable.lean:570-572) supplies the redundant algebraicity condition automatically for fields. The finite-extension formulation is the equivalent characterization already recorded in the blueprint, not an additional definition or existence assertion; IsSepClosed.algebraMap_bijective (lines 211-213) gives triviality of any separable extension. The project theorem IsSepClosed.iff_forall_finrank_eq_one (WeilConjectures/Mathlib/FieldTheory/IsSepClosed.lean) independently proves the stated equivalence; it does not cover the separable-closure definition and is not an attachment for the entire item.

blueprint_notes.text:
*Implementation note.* Mathlib's `IsSepClosed K` is stated as "every separable
polynomial over $K$ splits", which is equivalent to the formulation above. The
picard-schemes chapter defines the same notion again in that polynomial form, as
[def-pc-separably-closed].

lean.note: The old record named only IsSepClosed, although the node also defines a separable closure. The same Mathlib module defines IsSepClosure k K by separably closed top field and Algebra.IsSeparable k K (which implies algebraic). Record both existing declarations, without duplicating either definition.
